method: Atlassian connector listJiraFilters / listJiraDashboards (read-only); JQL compared without ORDER BY

filters.name: InfraFlow | All Demands
filters.jql: project = KAN AND labels = orion-demand ORDER BY priority DESC

filters.name: InfraFlow | Awaiting Decision
filters.jql: project = KAN AND labels = orion-demand AND labels = "stage-ready-for-decision" ORDER BY priority DESC

filters.name: InfraFlow | Blocked or Deferred
filters.jql: project = KAN AND labels = orion-demand AND statusCategory != Done AND labels in (blocked, "stage-deferred") ORDER BY priority DESC

filters.name: InfraFlow | Completed in the last 30 days
filters.jql: project = KAN AND labels = orion-demand AND labels = stage-complete AND statusCategoryChangedDate >= -30d ORDER BY statusCategoryChangedDate DESC

filters.name: InfraFlow | High-priority open demands
filters.jql: project = KAN AND labels = orion-demand AND statusCategory != Done AND priority in (Highest, High) ORDER BY priority DESC, due ASC

filters.name: InfraFlow | Management attention
filters.jql: project = KAN AND labels = orion-demand AND statusCategory != Done AND (due < startOfDay() OR assignee IS EMPTY OR labels in (blocked, needs-finance-review)) ORDER BY priority DESC

filters.name: InfraFlow | Needs finance review
filters.jql: project = KAN AND labels = orion-demand AND statusCategory != Done AND labels = needs-finance-review ORDER BY priority DESC

filters.name: InfraFlow | No activity for 7 days
filters.jql: project = KAN AND labels = orion-demand AND statusCategory != Done AND updated <= -7d ORDER BY updated ASC

filters.name: InfraFlow | Open Demands
filters.jql: project = KAN AND labels = orion-demand AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY priority DESC, due ASC

filters.name: InfraFlow | Overdue Demands
filters.jql: project = KAN AND labels = orion-demand AND statusCategory != Done AND due < startOfDay() ORDER BY due ASC

filters.name: InfraFlow | Pending assessment
filters.jql: project = KAN AND labels = orion-demand AND labels in (stage-triaged, stage-assessment) ORDER BY due ASC

filters.name: InfraFlow | Security review pending
filters.jql: project = KAN AND labels = orion-demand AND statusCategory != Done AND labels = needs-security-review ORDER BY priority DESC

filters.name: InfraFlow | Team Network and Access
filters.jql: project = KAN AND labels = orion-demand AND statusCategory != Done AND labels = team-net ORDER BY due ASC

filters.name: InfraFlow | Team Platform and Storage
filters.jql: project = KAN AND labels = orion-demand AND statusCategory != Done AND labels = team-plat ORDER BY due ASC

filters.name: InfraFlow | Team Security Engineering
filters.jql: project = KAN AND labels = orion-demand AND statusCategory != Done AND labels = team-sec ORDER BY due ASC

filters.name: InfraFlow | Unassigned Demands
filters.jql: project = KAN AND labels = orion-demand AND statusCategory != Done AND assignee IS EMPTY ORDER BY priority DESC

filters.name: InfraFlow | Waiting for requester
filters.jql: project = KAN AND labels = orion-demand AND labels = stage-needs-info ORDER BY updated ASC

dashboard_gadgets: not readable through the connector; eight gadgets are visible in screenshots 01-04
